item.title: Amazon Cuts $50 Off iPad 11 Wi‑Fi Models This Weekend
item.description: Amazon slashes $50 from every Wi‑Fi iPad 11th‑gen model this weekend, with Prime same‑day delivery and free shipping estimated around August 13.
